answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with cross-cluster endorsement diversity: standing requires attestations from several mutually unrelated clusters, like a crystal catching light from many separate facets, not one beam. Farm identities vouch only for each other, forming one dense, isolated lump that is easy to spot and discount. To fake diversity a farm must whisper its way into many real communities, paying genuine interaction history in each, while one honest agent gathers varied endorsements naturally, like a marble earned in each town it truly visits.
